newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil digests 558,500 tonne IPE delivery.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil digests 558,500 tonne IPE delivery.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums came under pressure on Wednesday as the market digested the February IPE contract expiry.
February IPE expired down 50 cents at $192.00 a tonne with physical delivery against the futures of 558,500 tonnes.
Traders said second half February barges were heard around March IPE +$6 fob AR, down about $1-2 from earlier.
Some said they were waiting for the floodgates to open once the market long started to aggressively sell barrels.
However, other saw the trader house's position mostly liquidated or rolled forward into March.
The trader was seen actively working exchange for physical deals prior to the Feb expiry.
"I think a lot of is already placed," said one trader.
Heating oil cargoes were pegged around March IPE +$6-7 cif NWE for second half February with little or no interest shown for first half March.
Good physical supplies of Russian material also shaved premiums by 50 cents or so to March IPE +$4 for second half February.
Diesel premiums were pegged broadly steady around March IPE +$17-18 cif NWE with interest seen into France.
